answer: To prevent sybil attacks, an economy can enforce a work requirement where each new identity must solve a quartz-based puzzle that takes a significant amount of time to complete, making it costly for attackers to create multiple identities. At the summit of each epoch, the economy pays out to valid identities that have completed the required work. If an attacker tries to create multiple identities, they will be slowed down by the puzzle, allowing the economy to detect and prevent the sybil attack, as the tide of new identities will be limited by the time it takes to solve the puzzle.
